findings: The archive contains a complete ABBS 2.0 preservation source tree with 246 ZIP entries, of which 238 are files.
The source tree contains 72 C files and 51 assembler files, plus documentation and ARexx material.
Node-local state is represented extensively through NodeBase-relative fields and node status routines.
Carrier-loss handling is directly observed in transfer.asm through Setup+Nodemem checks, NoCarrier state, and logoff paths.
The source includes user, node, transfer, message, browser, serial, and command-processing subsystems.
This source snapshot corroborates the documented ABBS ARexx mappings but is not treated as a distinct public door ABI.
